# phron_server_quote (Data Source)

Checks a Server size against the size rules in effect and prices it. A size that breaks a rule is an answer (problems), not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phron_server_quote" "web" {
  vcpus      = 2
  memory_gib = 4
  disk_gib   = 40
  tier       = "shared"
  location   = "fsn1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk in GiB.
- `memory_gib` (Number) Memory in GiB.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.

### Optional

- `location` (String) The Location id; when empty, available is false.
- `operating_system_id` (String) Also check the size against this Operating System's minimum disk.
- `tier` (String) "shared" (default) or "dedicated".

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether a Server of this size can be created now in the Location.
- `backup_hourly_usd` (String) The hourly price of daily backups in USD.
- `hourly_usd` (String) The hourly price in USD as a decimal string; empty when problems is not empty.
- `id` (String) A description of the quoted size.
- `own_prefix` (Boolean) Whether a Server of this size owns its own /64.
- `problems` (List of String) Size rules the size breaks, as "field: reason".
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why not, when available is false.
